title: One of my days
simplified_paragraphs: 我今天7点起床吃东西，9点去学校上课。我的汉语不好，下午汉语老师帮助我学习，我们一起喝咖啡学习汉语。很谢谢我的汉语老师，现在都懂了。晚上6点，我回家和爸爸妈妈吃饭。今天不想看书了，睡觉吧！
traditional_paragraphs: 我今天7點起床吃東西，9點去學校上課。我的漢語不好，下午漢語老師幫助我學習，我們一起喝咖啡學習漢語。很謝謝我的漢語老師，現在都懂了。晚上6點，我回家和爸爸媽媽吃飯。今天不想看書了，睡覺吧！
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ jīn tiān 7 diǎn qǐ chuáng chī dōng xi，9 diǎn qù xué xiào shàng kè。 wǒ de Hàn yǔ bù hǎo， xià wǔ Hàn yǔ lǎo shī bāng zhù wǒ xué xí， wǒ men yī qǐ hē kā fēi xué xí Hàn yǔ。 hěn xiè xie wǒ de Hàn yǔ lǎo shī， xiàn zài dōu dǒng le。 wǎn shang 6 diǎn， wǒ huí jiā hé bà ba mā ma chī fàn。 jīn tiān bù xiǎng kàn shū le， shuì jiào ba！
english_paragraphs: I got up at seven today and had something to eat. At nine, I went to school for class. My Chinese isn’t very good, so in the afternoon, my Chinese teacher helped me study. We drank coffee and studied Chinese together. I’m very grateful to my teacher—now I understand it all. At six in the evening, I went home and had dinner with my parents. I don’t feel like reading tonight. Time for bed!
english_full: I got up at seven today and had something to eat. At nine, I went to school for class. My Chinese isn’t very good, so in the afternoon, my Chinese teacher helped me study. We drank coffee and studied Chinese together. I’m very grateful to my teacher—now I understand it all. At six in the evening, I went home and had dinner with my parents. I don’t feel like reading tonight. Time for bed!
